## Goal

Automatically scan, validate, and improve WordPress block accessibility to meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards.

## Scope

- WCAG 2.2 AA compliance scanning
- Automated accessibility checks
- Block component auditing
- Alt text validation
- Color contrast verification
- Keyboard navigation testing
- Accessibility reports and fixes

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Detects 95% of WCAG issues
- [ ] Auto-fixes for 50+ common issues
- [ ] Real-time scanning in editor
- [ ] Compliance reports generated
- [ ] Recommendations engine working
- [ ] Documentation clear and complete
- [ ] Tests passing
